title: What Does an ElevenLabs Voice Agent Cost? Pricing and Limits
desc:
How is an ElevenLabs voice agent billed? This episode explains what the official docs say: creating an agent is free, how voice only, multimodal and text only calls are charged, the silence discount, why the billed duration follows the connection, where to see LLM costs, how burst pricing raises your concurrency and what it costs, and the documented ways to cut LLM spend. Rates change, so we point you to the official pricing page for current numbers.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
